rows.name: Yarmouth
rows.description: In winter. Green outer light near castle wall; inner bright lt. In one, S.S.W., lead into the harbour. A fix. red lt. on end of wooden pier

rows.name: NEEDLES OUTER ROCK
rows.character: One occulting bright, red, or green light, ½ minute
rows.description: Granite tower, 109 feet high, white with one black band. Light eclipsed 3 secs. every ½ min., shows red to South from S.E. ½ S. to W. ½ S.; thence bright over entrance of Needles Channel to W. by N. ¾ N.; thence red up the Channel to N.E. ½ E.; thence bright to N.E. by E., to clear Warden Ledge; and green thence to the land

rows.name: Totland Bay
rows.description: A fixed green light on the pier

rows.name: Hurst Beach
rows.description: White towers, 85 and 52 ft. high, 223 yards apart N.E. by E. ¼ E., in rear of fortifications. High light visible between S.W. ¼ W. and W. by S. ¾ S., low light between S.W. and W. by S. ½ S. Leading light shown from high lt.-ho. up the Solent, betw. E. & E. by N. ½ N.

rows.name: Bournemouth
rows.description: A fixed red light on the pier

rows.name: Poole
rows.description: In one, N. ¾ W., 786 ft. apart, on North side of entrance; low lt. masked betw. S. ¾ W. and S. by W. ½ W. Red lights at town in winter

rows.name: DURLSTON HEAD
rows.description: White lighthouse, 39 ft. high, on Anvil Point, West part of head. A flash every 10 secs., visible between about W. ½ N. and E. by N.

rows.name: Weymouth
rows.description: Red lights near beach, East of railway station, in line bear N. by W. ¾ W. Green lights on North pier in line bear West

rows.name: PORTLAND
rows.description: White towers, 50 & 85 ft. high, 1,509 ft. apart, near the Bill. In one, N.W. by N., lead between Race and Shambles. Low light only shown between N.W. by W. ¾ W. and E.N.E.

rows.name: Portland Breakwater
rows.description: On centre of fort, at extremity. Lt. obscured by peninsula betw. S.S.W. and W. by S. ½ S.; & betw. W. by S. ½ S. & W.N.W. lt. is obscured to an observer 15 ft. above the sea when within 2 miles of Chesil Bank

rows.name: SHAMBLES SHL. LT.-V.
rows.description: At East end of shoal, in 15 fathoms. Flash of 5 secs., eclipse 6 secs., flash 1½ sec., eclipse 17½ secs. Red, with ball

rows.name: Lyme Regis
rows.description: In one, N.W. ½ N., 825 feet apart. Leading lights to inner pier-heads

rows.name: Sidmouth
rows.description: A fixed bright light on West side of creek

rows.name: Exmouth
rows.description: Two fixed red or bright lights

rows.name: Teignmouth
rows.description: One on a limestone tower, on S.W. end of Denn; the other on a house; lead to fairway

rows.name: Babbacombe
rows.description: Fishing light, green to N.E., red seaward, bright to S.W.

rows.name: Torquay
rows.description: Bright light on inner pier, showing red to westward; red light on outer pier

rows.name: Brixham
rows.description: Green light on West pier-head, and red light on end of breakwater

rows.name: Dartmouth
rows.character: 1. One fixed bright, red, or green light 2. One fixed bright lt. 3. One small fix. bright, red, or green light
rows.description: 1. On Kingswear or North side; bright light towards fairway, betw. S. ½ E. and S. by E. ¾ E.; thence red light to the land, and green light to S.W., between S. ½ E. and the land, or over Checkstone, Pin Rock, &c. 2. S. by E., 110 feet from former; in one lead up fairway 3. Near Coast-guard Station; bright in fairway, red over shoals on N. side of harbour, and green light over shoal of One Gun Point to S.

rows.name: START POINT
rows.character: One rev. br. lt., 1 min., and fixed bright light
rows.description: White tower, 92 feet high. A fixed light at 181 ft. is shown over Skerries Rocks between N.E. ¾ E. and E. ½ S. Signal Station to S.

rows.name: Plymouth Breakwater
rows.character: One occulting bright or red light, ½ min. Lower fixed bright light
rows.description: Granite tower, 76 ft. high, on W. end. Light eclipsed 3 secs. every ½ min.; bright seaward, betw. E. by S. ½ S. and N.E. ½ E., through South, and red over the anchorage. A lower bright light is seen when channel is open, between S.W. ¾ W. and S.W. by W. ¾ W.

rows.name: Plymouth Harbour
rows.description: Bright light on West Barbican pier-head; red lts. on Millbay piers, and also one at Mount Wise landing. Occulting bright light, 5 secs., on extremity of Mount Batten Breakwater
